items.title: Altria Group (MO) Faces Investigation Over On! PLUS FDA Disclosure Claims
items.summary: Levi & Korsinsky has opened an investigation into Altria Group regarding disclosures tied to the FDA regulatory status of its on! PLUS nicotine pouch product. The review focuses on whether Altria accurately described near term FDA authorization prospects for on! PLUS in its public statements. This action introduces an additional legal and regulatory consideration for investors following NYSE:MO. items.title: MO Q2 Deep Dive: Margin Pressure Amid Consumer Strain and Smoke-Free Investments
items.summary: Tobacco company Altria (NYSE:MO) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 1.2% year on year to $5.36 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.48 per share was 1.2% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
